question: Who initiated the 2024 campaign “Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam” to promote tree plantation in honour of mothers and nature?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Narendra Modi**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **“Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam” campaign:** The **Prime Minister of India, Narendra Modi**, initiated the campaign in **2024**. This campaign focuses on promoting **tree plantation** to honor mothers and nature. The initiative highlights the importance of ecological balance and environmental conservation.
 
• The campaign encourages individuals to plant trees as a tribute to their mothers, symbolizing **gratitude and nurturing values** associated with motherhood.
 
• The move aligns with India’s broader commitment to address **climate change** and enhance **green cover**, contributing to global sustainability goals.
 
• This initiative also seeks to instill a sense of responsibility among citizens towards preserving **nature** and fostering a culture of **environmental awareness**.
 
• The campaign is part of a series of programs aimed at achieving the government’s **environmental goals**, such as reducing carbon emissions and promoting sustainable practices.
 
• **Community involvement:** The campaign emphasizes community participation, urging citizens, especially the younger generation, to take active steps in addressing **environmental challenges**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Importance of tree plantation:**

 
 
• **Tree plantation** is a critical measure to combat **deforestation**, reduce **air pollution**, and mitigate the effects of **climate change**.
 
• Trees play a significant role in maintaining **ecological balance** by absorbing carbon dioxide, releasing oxygen, and supporting biodiversity.
 
• They also prevent **soil erosion**, improve soil fertility, and contribute to **water conservation**.
 
 
 
• **India’s environmental initiatives:**
 
 
• The Indian government has launched several programs such as the **National Afforestation Program (NAP)** and the **Green India Mission**, aimed at increasing forest cover and promoting sustainable environmental practices.
 
• India has committed to achieving **net zero carbon emissions** by **2070** as part of its climate action plan under the **Paris Agreement**.
 
• **Clean India Mission:** Campaigns like “Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam” align with the government’s broader initiatives such as **Swachh Bharat Abhiyan** to ensure clean and green surroundings.
 
 
 
• **Impact of campaigns:**
 
 
• Such campaigns aim to create **awareness** and mobilize mass participation in environmental conservation efforts.
 
• They also contribute to fostering a **culture of sustainability** and responsibility, especially among the younger generation.
 
• These initiatives have a long-term impact on mitigating environmental challenges and improving the overall quality of life.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Objective of the campaign:**

 
 
• The primary objective is to combine the ideas of **environmental conservation** and **emotional connection** with mothers, making the initiative more relatable and impactful.
 
• The campaign also seeks to address the global issue of **climate change** by encouraging large-scale tree plantation.
 
 
 
• **Example of similar initiatives:**
 
 
• Initiatives like **Van Mahotsav** in India have been promoting tree plantation since 1950, highlighting the importance of afforestation and environmental conservation.
 
• Globally, campaigns such as the **Trillion Tree Campaign** by the United Nations aim to restore ecosystems by planting billions of trees worldwide.
